choices.content: Finding out the lifespan of a batch of light bulbs
Finding out the weights of 45 students in a class
Finding out how audiences nationwide rate a particular film
Finding out the water quality of the Yangtze River

question.prompt: Which of the following surveys is suitable for a census?

solutions.explanation: A census is suitable when there are very few subjects and measurements are easy to take. Testing the lifespan of light bulbs is destructive, while nationwide audiences and the water quality of the Yangtze River cover large scopes, so sampling is appropriate for these.
solutions.title: Compare census feasibility
